name: sensor_contact_response
description: Compare up to four recent recorded frames after short hand motions. Returns measured world-frame hand translations/rotations and bilateral marker-field changes matched by reference pixel position, handling shuffled marker rows. Use it to distinguish hand travel from evolving contact evidence before repeating a motion or judging completion. The repeated-translation flag is a measurement pattern, not proof of blockage or insertion. It cannot measure object progress, infer a hidden hole axis, estimate force, or decide task success; inspect camera/depth evidence when those are needed.

marker_match_radius_px.description: Maximum distance between reference pixel coordinates for mutual-nearest matching.

min_marker_matches.description: Minimum distinct mutual matches per finger and interval.

marker_change_threshold_px.description: Median matched marker-change threshold for the bilateral-response flag. This is not a force or success threshold.
